OUTPUT.description: Folder that render and apply write the harness files to.

OSF_DATA.description: State folder: apply records the applied version here and plan compares with it.

FACTORY_MCP_REGISTRY.description: Base URL of the MCP Registry that plan reads to pin registry servers in factory.lock.

FACTORY_INFERENCE_URL.description: Base URL of the inference gateway that every ModelConfig of render --k8s points at.

FACTORY_SANDBOX_IMAGES.description: Registry folder of the sandbox images; render --k8s uses <folder>/<sandbox.template> as the image.

FACTORY_FORGE_URL.description: Base URL of the Forgejo that holds the repositories; apply registers webhooks there and plan reads them.

FACTORY_FORGE_TOKEN.description: API token for FACTORY_FORGE_URL with the scope write:repository. Never written to a file.

FACTORY_INTAKE_URL.description: URL every webhook of the factory delivers to, for example the intake.

FACTORY_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Secret that signs the webhook deliveries. Optional; never written to a file.
